entities.name: Pallar Ojanen
entities.description: An Efravan leonin refugee from Dominaria, sister of Zar and mother of Lark.

entities.name: Zar Ojanen
entities.description: Pallar's sister, a warrior dedicated to their people's survival.

entities.name: Lark Ojanen
entities.description: Pallar's daughter, born at the story's end.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: A leonin people fleeing the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A threat once thought eradicated from Dominaria.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A city whose inhabitants were hostile to the Efravan.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: A healer who supported Pallar and advocated for the Efravan.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: The magistrate who reluctantly accepted the Efravan into the city.

events.summary: Pallar and her tribe wandered the Great Desert seeking safety from the Phyrexians, facing hostility from Femeref.
events.quote: Pallar was an Efravan refugee who, along with her tribe, had been wandering the Great Desert

events.summary: Pallar gave birth to her daughter Lark.
events.quote: The story culminated with the successful birth of her daughter, Lark

events.summary: Sidar Teshunda reluctantly accepted the Efravan into the city thanks to Niambi's advocacy.
events.quote: the reluctant but eventual acceptance of the Efravan into the city by Sidar Teshunda

relations.quote: She is the sister of Zar Ojanen
Pallar remained hopeful and trusting in Niambi
